periods.time: vol-09 ch-003, during the department-store interlude

name.zh: 史黛菈接住瞬间移动婴儿

periods.summary: A baby Blazer accidentally teleports into midair in a restroom; Stella catches him, and Sara later calms him with maternal tenderness.
periods.cause: A very young Blazer named Nitta Makoto appears to have awakened a space-movement ability before self-control and teleports away from his mother.
periods.process: After changing out of the bunny outfit, Stella sees the baby appear behind her in a mirror and catches him before he falls headfirst. Ikki, Stella and Sara take him to the lost-child office. When he wakes and cries, Ikki and Stella panic, but Sara calmly takes him, explains that adults' anxiety worsens children's fear, lets him seek warmth against her breast, and sings an Italian lullaby.
periods.outcome: The infant falls asleep peacefully and is later returned safely to his mother from the neighboring department store.
periods.aftermath: Ikki and Stella see Sara's most beautiful and maternal side, softening their view of her before the match.
periods.significance: Shows the hazards of early Blazer ability awakening and reveals Sara's observation, gentleness and hidden motherliness.
